Consequently, the facility will adopt a more energy-intensive closed-loop liquid cooling system. This transition comes amidst Sydney's growing demand for data centers. Notably, the S7 data center is projected to generate thousands of jobs during its construction phase.

title: KL Rahul injury scare? India coach gives big update after batter retires hurt

Rahul scored 77 off 162 balls and shared a 150-run stand with Devdutt Padikkal. Padikkal hit an unbeaten 131 on his Test comeback, while India finished day one strongly at 288 for two.

title: Indian-American CEO who sacked 900 over Zoom gets fired himself

Garg's removal follows his controversial 2021 mass layoff of 900 employees.  He is now seeking to regain his position and is offering to work for one dollar annually.  Better's market value has significantly decreased since its pandemic-era peak.

title: Devdutt Padikkal joins Virat Kohli in elite club after historic ton vs Sri Lanka
description: On Independence Day, Devdutt Padikkal made history by becoming the second Indian and the first to score an international Test century on August 15. His remarkable innings had him finishing Day 1 undefeated at 131 runs, solidifying his place at number three in the batting order. This impressive achievement marks the end of India's long wait for a Test century from that position.

title: A ton of class! Devdutt Padikkal makes the long wait count

Karnataka captaincy, role clarity and work on his game against spin reaped rewards as he put India in a dominant position with his maiden ton and a 150-run stand with his statemate and coffee partner KL Rahul on the opening day of the first Test in Galle.

Makhachev aims to extend his impressive winning streak to seventeen victories. Garry, an underdog, seeks to build his own significant fighting legacy.

Power lines have been laid up to Rasgadi, with Bugdiyar also slated for electrification shortly.

Unfavorable opinions dominate across the border, with India marking Pakistan as the major threat while Pakistan responds in kind. There is a notable distrust regarding the other’s dedication to peaceful relations, amplified by contrasting global alliances influencing each country’s strategic outlook.

description: MacKenzie Scott has pioneered large-scale medical debt relief through significant donations. Her gifts enabled the abolition of over forty billion dollars in medical debt. This initiative has provided relief to millions of families across all fifty states. Other billionaires have been inspired by this effective philanthropic model. However, policy reform remains stalled, highlighting the model's limitations.

title: Zohran Mamdani’s ‘common sense regulation’ may push Amazon to move NYC deliveries
description: In New York City, Mayor Zohran Mamdani is advocating for a bill that mandates direct employment for delivery drivers. Amazon has raised concerns that this legislation could push its delivery services outside the city limits. Critics point out that the bill might lead to a sharp increase in delivery costs for residents. Additionally, opponents warn that the legislation could jeopardize countless delivery jobs and adversely affect local businesses.
